title: Mexican Wholesome Corn Bowl
description: A vibrant and nutritious Mexican-inspired bowl filled with wholesome ingredients, sweet corn, and a hint of spices.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Rinse the sweet potato and roast for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Cook the quinoa according to package instructions.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the cooked black beans and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the thawed corn, roasted sweet potato, and cooked quinoa to the pan. Stir to combine.
Squeeze the lime juice over the top and stir to combine.
Top with diced avocado and chopped cilantro.
